subject: Foil lapel pin proofs + split fulfillment plan
messages:
From: Kate Hsu <kate@artifexpins.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Production hold on Foil lapel pins (PO #1152) — options attached

Hi Rishi and Laura,

Quick update from the floor: during final plating QC we flagged a surface inconsistency across the first tooling batch for the foil layer on the lapel pins for FeatherTech. The defect affects approximately 40% of the first run; the rest pass our visual tolerance. We can do one of two paths: 

1) Remake the affected tooling and re-run the full order — estimated 10 extra business days, no additional unit cost, but full shipment delayed.
2) Split fulfillment: we send the 60% of units that passed now, and we run a local short-run (matte nickel finish) for the remaining 40% with an alternate finishing house in our regional partner network — turnaround 4–6 business days. The split will change the finish slightly (matte nickel vs. mirror foil); I attached a side-by-side proof.

Attached: artifex_pin_proof_v4.png (proofs v4), artifex_quote_1152.pdf (updated quote reflecting split-run pricing).

If you want us to proceed with option 2, we need written sign-off on the alternate finish and an updated PO for the partial shipment. Also note: if you need identical finish for all units, we recommend option 1.

Apologies for the disruption — we can expedite packing for the partial shipment and provide a packing manifest and tracking once items leave.

Best,
Kate
Production Manager, Artifex Pins
[Attachment: artifex_pin_proof_v4.png (PNG, 1.1MB)]
[Attachment: artifex_quote_1152.pdf (PDF, 78KB)]

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Kate Hsu <kate@artifexpins.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 9 Nov 2025 09:34:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Production hold on Foil lapel pins (PO #1152) — options attached

Thanks for the quick heads-up, Kate.

Option 2 (split fulfillment) sounds acceptable given our timeline — FeatherTech needs the majority of items on-site for the Nov 18 pop-up. Two asks before we sign off: 
- Can you send a line-item breakdown of shipping dates for the partial shipment (items/qty + estimated ship date)?
- Confirm whether the alternate matte nickel will affect the enamel colors or doming profile. Laura, Marissa — are we okay with a slightly different finish on 40% of units for this event?

Logan Wright on our ops team can coordinate the local short-run if you need a contact: logan.wright@redwoodinference.com. If procurement needs a revised PO, loop in the finance/procurement email and we’ll get it over.

If you can turn around the packing manifest and the updated quote by EOD, I’ll escalate to procurement for an immediate PO.

Appreciate it — Rishi
Head of Sales, Events & Partnerships
Redwood Inference

Rishi / Kate —

I'm fine approving the split-run for this event provided these two conditions are met: 
1) The matte nickel sample (attached) matches the pantone for the purple enamel within a delta of <=2 (send a color delta report if available).
2) Packaging and foam insert specs remain identical so presentation at the booth is consistent — we don't want a mix of foam colors or different card stock.

Kate: please confirm the insert spec (thickness, foam die-cut outline) and whether the partial shipment will be kitted the same way. Also include the expected ship date for the 60% and the ETA for the remaining 40%.

Marissa — FYI on event budget impact; if the split adds incremental freight, we'll need pre-approval.

Thanks,

All — approved to proceed with split-run from a budget perspective on the condition that the incremental freight is under $450. If the split-run freight line exceeds that, we need a quick sign-off from finance (cc'd procurement is paige.procure@redwoodinference.com).

Also: can Artifex confirm the packing dimensions for the partial carton that will ship immediately? We need to book a final local courier for last-mile delivery to the venue and want to avoid repacking on arrival.

One small ask: if the alternate finish will be visibly different, please add a small sticker to those units' packaging ("Alternate finish — shipped separately") so booth staff can identify them.

Thanks — Marissa

Subject: Re: Production hold on Foil lapel pins (PO #1152) — options attached

Thanks everyone — confirms: we will proceed with option 2 (split fulfillment) per approvals. Summary below: 

• Partial shipment (60% = 1,200 units) — packed & kitted identically; foam insert spec: 3mm EVA with die-cut outline A7 (same as original). ETA to Redwood staging (FedEx acct) 2025-11-14 17:00 PST. Packing manifest attached.
• Short-run (40% = 800 units) — produced by regional partner; finish: matte nickel (see proof). ETA 2025-11-18; we will ship directly to venue if you confirm address.
• Incremental freight estimate for split: $312 (below Marissa threshold).
• We will add the "Alternate finish — shipped separately" sticker to the 800-unit boxes as requested.

Attached: packing_manifest_partial_1152.csv, artifex_quote_1152.pdf (final with freight line).

Next steps: Rishi — if you send an updated PO referencing PO #1152 (partial release 1 of 2), we will schedule the partial pick-up tomorrow morning. We will also provide FastLine tracking once the partial leaves the facility (tracking link: https://tracking.fastline.com/track/FX123456789).

Apologies again for the tooling issue — we pushed extra QC to ensure the second run meets the mirror-foil spec.

Best,
Kate
Production Manager, Artifex Pins
